parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: The region ID of the service.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the query range, in UTC. The default value is the current time.

parameters.name: EventType
parameters.description:
The event type. Valid values:

- Normal: a normal event.

- Warning: a warning event.

parameters.name: InstanceName
parameters.description: The name of the service instance. To obtain this name, see [ListServiceInstances](~~412108~~).

parameters.name: PageNum
parameters.description: The page number to return. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of events to return per page. Default value: 100.

parameters.name: ServiceName
parameters.description: The name of the service. To obtain this name, see [ListServices](~~412109~~).

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the query range, in UTC. The default value is 7 days ago.
